segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, second page's minetn entry) to Minetown. Its Lua variants run table-form des.room with a contents callback that nests des.room subrooms, the wall form of des.door, des.altar inside a temple, and des.random_corridors, through lspo_room, spo_endroom, lspo_door, sel_set_door, lspo_altar, and lspo_random_corridors.
